dedupe_keys.name: wider impacts in transport appraisal software and manuals

description: WITA is software described by the Department for Transport for appraising the wider economic impacts of transport schemes. It captures welfare effects from employment, investment and productivity that are outside conventional transport user-benefit calculations. It follows DfT wider-economic-impacts guidance. Geographic extent and appraisal periods depend on the scheme; the inspected page does not specify input formats or resolution. Atkins supplies the software under a paid site licence, with an educational option. Users need an active licence and account credentials to download it. The software licence is separate from the GOV.UK documentation terms. The tool supports economic assessment of transport investments and complements TUBA. Caveats: no installer or manual was downloaded and the calculations were not tested. A separately linked R mapping tool is an unresolved related resource and is not bundled into this record.
